propiedades.duplicar.ayuda: Make a copy of this element (Ctrl+D)
propiedades.posicion.ayuda: In display pixels ({ancho} × {alto}). You can also drag it on the canvas.
propiedades.texto.ayuda: What will be written on the display.
propiedades.traducido: This text is translated ({idiomas}): here you only change the one for this language; the original and the others stay as they are.
propiedades.traducido.quitar: This text has translations ({idiomas}), but not for this language: if you change it, the original changes and the translations are removed, since they'd no longer match.
propiedades.traducido.sensor: “Before” or “After” are translated ({idiomas}): if the one you change has this language, only that one changes; if not, the original changes and its translations are removed.
propiedades.reloj.ayuda: The time and date are written in English, using your PC's clock.
propiedades.sensor.ayuda: The PC value to show. On the right you see its current value.
propiedades.largo.ayuda: If the text is longer, it's cut with “…”.
propiedades.antes.ayuda: Text in front of the value. Leave a space at the end to separate it.
propiedades.despues.ayuda: Text after the value (and after the unit, if shown).
propiedades.intervalo.ayuda: Fewer seconds = more up to date, but a bit more work for the PC.
propiedades.barra.sensor.ayuda: The bar fills up with this value. Only numeric ones are listed.
propiedades.imagen.ayuda: It fits the box without being stretched.
propiedades.alineacion.ayuda: Inside its box. Vertically it's always centered.
propiedades.fondo.ayuda: When off, the theme background shows through.
